findings.motion: Assembly floor: SB 1174 Senate third reading, passed
findings.note: SB 1174 (Min), Elections: voter identification, bars local governments from setting voter ID rules. Source is CalMatters Digital Democracy. She voted aye on Assembly third reading.

findings.motion: Assembly floor: third reading, AB 1116 passed
findings.note: AB 1116 (Berman), voter registration, would let people register online without a California driver license or state ID by giving the last four digits of their Social Security number. Source is CalMatters Digital Democracy. She voted aye.
